verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents a general Uptime API with bearer-token auth capable of 'managing anything' (including presumably incidents) and a dedicated MCP server plus AI SRE agent that can be invoked from Slack/Teams/LLM workflows to investigate incidents, draft postmortems, and open tickets/PRs. However, the evidence never shows a documented API/MCP endpoint or agent action that explicitly acknowledges, escalates, or resolves an incident end-to-end — acknowledgment examples given are dashboard/Slack/phone/mobile-tap based, not agentic API/MCP calls. Missing for 10: explicit API/MCP endpoints for incident acknowledge/escalate/resolve, and confirmation the AI SRE agent itself performs these lifecycle actions rather than just investigation/reporting.
